heading: INT. NORTHSIDE SOUND - LIVE ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NORTHSIDE SOUND - LIVE ROOM - NIGHT
ON CAMERA: handheld, shaky, a red REC dot in the corner.
The mic stand fills the frame, then swings toward JUNIPER, 19, headphones around their neck, staring at a lyric sheet.
This is take nineteen. They said twelve was fine. I said twelve was fine.
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: Twelve was not fine.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: The camera whips left.
OSEI, 20s, engineer, hunched at the glass of the control room.
A studio dog sleeps under his chair.
A pizza guy hovers at the door with two boxes, unsure whether to knock.
You rushed the bridge.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: I didn't rush -- they're the one who
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: -- you came in early on "stay" --
units.name: OSEI

units.text: -- because the click track is wrong, Osei, it's wrong, I told you --
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: A phone BUZZES on the console.
Osei thumbs it.
Speaker.
Hi, babe, is it done? The label guy is asking.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: He's asking?
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: Marguerite, not now --
units.name: OSEI

units.text: -- he wants the single Friday, Juniper, they have a slot, and you promised --
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: I never promised! You promised! You said I'd get to say when it's done!
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: Juniper rips the headphones off and hurls them.
They CRACK against the glass.
The dog bolts.
The pizza guy backs out.
The camera drops, tilts, catches the ceiling tiles, and cuts to black.
